---
applyTo: 'workshop_description.bbcode'
---

## Description Structure Guidelines
- **ALWAYS** start the description with a plain text paragraph (no headers or BBCode tags)
- The first ~100 characters are displayed as plain text in Steam's tooltip preview when hovering over the mod
- This opening paragraph should be a concise, clear summary of what the mod does
- After the opening paragraph, you can use headers and formatting tags as needed

## Steam Text Syntax to LLM Instruction Mapping

Source: [https://steamcommunity.com/comment/Guide/formattinghelp](https://steamcommunity.com/comment/Guide/formattinghelp)

### 1. Bold
- **Steam Syntax**: `[b]bold[/b]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render the enclosed text as **bold**.

### 2. Italic
- **Steam Syntax**: `[i]italic[/i]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render the enclosed text as *italic*.

### 3. Underline
- **Steam Syntax**: `[u]underline[/u]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render the enclosed text with an underline.

### 4. Strikethrough
- **Steam Syntax**: `[strike]text[/strike]` or `[s]text[/s]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render the enclosed text with a strikethrough.

### 5. Hyperlink
- **Steam Syntax**: `[url]http://example.com[/url]` or `[url=http://example.com]Link Text[/url]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render the text as a clickable hyperlink. If label provided, display label and link to the URL.

### 6. Code
- **Steam Syntax**: `[code]code block[/code]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render the enclosed text in a monospaced code block without syntax highlighting.

### 7. Header / Title
- **Steam Syntax**: `[h1]Header Text[/h1]` (also h2–h5)
- **LLM Instruction**: Render the enclosed text as a header (level 1 to 5 based on the tag).

### 8. Quotation
- **Steam Syntax**: `[quote]quoted text[/quote]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Format the enclosed text as a blockquote.

### 9. List
- **Steam Syntax**: `[list][*]Item 1[*]Item 2[/list]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render a bulleted list from items enclosed by `[*]`.

### 10. Numbered List
- **Steam Syntax**: `[olist][*]First[*]Second[/olist]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render a numbered list from items enclosed by `[*]`.

### 11. Image
- **Steam Syntax**: `[img]http://image_url.com[/img]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Display an image using the specified URL.

### 12. Spoiler
- **Steam Syntax**: `[spoiler]hidden text[/spoiler]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render the enclosed text as hidden/spoiler content, requiring user interaction to reveal.

### 13. Table
- **Steam Syntax**: `[table][tr][td]A[/td][td]B[/td][/tr][/table]`
- **LLM Instruction**: Render a table with rows (`[tr]`) and columns (`[td]`) based on tag nesting.

---
**Note**: Ensure formatting tags are closed properly to prevent rendering issues.

## Character Encoding Guidelines
- **ALWAYS** use web-safe ASCII symbols in Steam Workshop descriptions
- Replace special Unicode characters with their ASCII equivalents:
  - Use straight apostrophe `'` instead of curly apostrophe `'` or `'`
  - Use straight quotes `"` instead of curly quotes `"` or `"`
  - Use hyphen `-` instead of em dash `—` or en dash `–`
  - Use three periods `...` instead of ellipsis `…`
- These substitutions ensure consistent rendering across all platforms and browsers
- Steam Workshop may not properly display Unicode characters in all contexts

## Auto-Generated Content Guidelines
- **DO NOT** manually add Workshop ID or Mod ID lines to workshop_description.bbcode
- These identifiers are auto-generated by Steam Workshop and should not be included in the description file:
  ```
  Workshop ID: 1234567890
  Mod ID: YourUsername_YourModName
  ```
- Steam automatically appends this information when the mod is published
